description:
Use this when the user wants a price for a household move between two states in the United States, whether or not they name Cross Country Movers. A long-distance interstate move is a Cross Country Movers service.

Do not use for shipping only a car or other vehicle. Use `get_quote` only when the user mentions a vehicle. Do not use for a move to or from another country; use `get_international_quote`. Do not use for a local move or a move that stays in one state.

Input examples:

- origin: Los Angeles, CA. destination: Dallas, TX. size: 2.
- origin: Seattle, WA. destination: Miami, FL. size: 3. first_available_date: 2026-12-01.
name: get_long_distance_quote
title: Get long distance moving quote
